sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Middle-Market Cross-Border Cross-Industry M&A Advisory Boutique

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; no separate sub-state tax or registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary law, with unified national statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation avoidance agreement currently in force for Vanuatu
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) — regional trade and economic partnership instrument
Australia–Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement — applicable exchange of information instrument

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2014 (as amended); VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidelines; International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 20 of 2014; all addressing customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, and UBO record-keeping through VFSC-licensed registered agents
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — the registered agent maintains the confidential beneficial-ownership register; the register is not public and may be accessed by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit on lawful demand

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each individual UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the relevant jurisdiction; notarized by a licensed notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille contracting party; documents originating outside Vanuatu must be notarized and legalized through the nearest Vanuatu consulate or diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / banker's due diligence reference for each individual and corporate UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank; signed by an authorized bank officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Accepted only if transmitted directly by secure authenticated banking channel (SWIFT/traced e-mail) from the issuing bank; physically delivered letters must be notarized and consular legalized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address, such as utility bill or original bank statement, not older than three months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding bank in the document country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization after notarization; direct bank-sourced electronic confirmation may be accepted by the registered agent without legalization on a risk-based basis

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, or register of directors and shareholders for any corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction or licensed corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is a Hague Apostille contracting state and the Vanuatu registered agent confirms acceptance; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth and background declaration for natural-person UBOs involved in cross-border M&A advisory scope
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant beneficial owner signed before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and subsequent consular legalization; independent documentary source-of-wealth evidence must accompany the signed declaration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, the VFSC-licensed registered agent must screen every UBO, director, shareholder, and authorized signatory, as well as all related corporate layers, against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU consolidated sanctions lists, UK HM Treasury sanctions regime, and Vanuatu FIU or VFSC local designations. PEP status triggers enhanced customer due diligence, senior management approval, and source-of-wealth documentation. Ongoing monitoring and transaction screening are required under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2014, as amended, with records retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry — online name search and reservation through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; official portal accessible at www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: An International Company name may be registered in Latin/ASCII script. English, French, and Bislama names are permissible. If a proposed name includes a foreign-language word or non-Latin character, the registered agent must submit a certified phonetic transliteration and a sworn English or French translation. The name must not be false, misleading, offensive, or confusingly similar to an existing Vanuatu or foreign registered company, trade mark, or protected name. The legal suffix must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' unless VFSC expressly approves an equivalent statutory suffix.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name application is rejected, the VFSC-licensed registered agent may, within 14 business days of the rejection notice, file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Companies Registry. The appeal must attach the original rejection notice, the proposed name, the prior name-search certificate, evidence of trademark and registry non-conflict, and, where applicable, a ministerial consent application for any prohibited or sensitive token. VFSC must issue a final decision in writing within 21 business days. If the appeal is successful, a fresh 30-day reservation is granted. Before expiry, a single 30-day extension may be requested for a prescribed fee; an adverse final decision may be referred to the Minister responsible for financial services for administrative review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office cannot satisfy the registered-office obligation. Every Vanuatu International Company must maintain a physical registered office at the premises of its VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. For an M&A advisory boutique, the registered agent will additionally require demonstrable commercial substance, including client engagement files, board decision records, accounting records, and a usable physical communication address; virtual mail-forwarding may be used only as an ancillary support and not as the statutory address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For the stated Medium-Risk Enhanced AML tier and the licensed cross-border M&A advisory scope, the estimated probability of a targeted or unannounced VFSC/registered-agent inspection within the first 12 months is 15–25%. A passive international company without an active financial-services endorsement would carry a materially lower inspection probability of approximately 5–10%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company name search and name reservation fee
VFSC International Company incorporation registration fee
First-year registered agent and registered office service fee
Pre-incorporation AML/CFT customer due diligence and UBO piercing profile compilation
OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and Vanuatu FIU sanctions and PEP screening per proposed director and UBO batch
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent / third-party screening data provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, consular legalization, apostille chain where accepted, and diplomatic courier handling for UBO documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, consulate, and courier service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff plus prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced source-of-wealth/source-of-funds desk review for Medium-Risk Enhanced M&A advisory scope
VFSC financial-services licence pre-application and fit-and-proper assessment fee, where applicable to M&A advisory activity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff and prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222], ss 5–18 (incorporation), ss 30–38 (constitution and registered office), ss 49–57 (directors); Companies (Amendment) Act 2020
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — International Companies and Trusts Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None prescribed by law; no minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement, nominal capital may be as low as USD 1 or deferred share capital
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that (1) the subscribers listed in the Memorandum and Articles hereby subscribe for the shares allocated to them and the directors are authorized to issue share certificates; (2) the Registered Office of the Company shall be established at the address of the licensed registered agent and such agent is retained; (3) the following officers are appointed: Director, Secretary, and Compliance Officer, each to serve in accordance with the Articles; (4) the appointed officers are authorized to open banking accounts, engage counsel, and execute all filings necessary to effect these resolutions; and (5) these resolutions shall take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Registry Counter or Online Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the prescribed name reservation form with three ranked corporate names. Include proposed activity and confirm the name contains no restricted terms. VFSC will issue a name availability notice before incorporation.
required_dossiers: Copy of applicant passport or certificate of identity
Brief description of proposed business activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or reserved for another party, submit a revised name list within 5 business days; if the refusal is based on restricted terms, amend the name or request VFSC written guidance for an administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent — VFSC-approved corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, subscriber details, consents, and internal governance precedents. Ensure compliance with International Companies Act and VFSC circulars.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and officer
Letter of engagement from licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If drafting is queried by the agent or VFSC, revise the affected clauses as instructed and resubmit; any ambiguity in objects clauses should be clarified before execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and issuance of certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC1 with executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent certificate, and consents. Pay the state filing fee via VFSC approved bank transfer or cashier. The Certificate of Incorporation is issued upon registration.
required_dossiers: Form IC1 (signed by subscribers and registered agent)
Proof of payment of government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or requisition, respond in writing within 14 calendar days, correct the relevant document, and pay any re-filing fee; if the matter is complex, request a VFSC consultation meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of registered office and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Record the registered office address at the agent's licensed address in Port Vila; adopt the initial board resolutions, issue share certificates, and open the statutory registers for members, directors, and charges.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent fails to file the notice on time, coordinate with VFSC to accept a late registration with a single combined filing; ensure all dates on consents align to avoid further query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance and corporate record keeping
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / Company Secretary / VFSC Registry Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the statutory first board meeting to ratify incorporation, approve the issue of shares, adopt a compliance framework, and authorize the opening of client monies and operating accounts. File any post-incorporation changes with VFSC.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If annual obligations are missed, file a penalty statement and submit to VFSC within 30 days; for governance gaps, pass a ratifying board resolution and file the corrective minutes with the registry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Licensing and Compliance Unit
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Registration and Financial Services Licence (Investment / M&A Advisory Category)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 — Exempt from full EIA for office-based professional consultancy; no local physical manufacturing or extraction activity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generated; office waste must comply with municipal solid waste regulations and the Vanuatu Waste Management Act; electronic waste disposed through approved recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from Vanuatu Fire Services; building occupancy permit from Port Vila Municipal Council; workplace health and safety assessment for office premises, including fire extinguishers, emergency exits, electrical safety, and safe work desk ergonomics.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Finance and Treasury, Inland Revenue Division, Vanuatu (VRMS online portal: https://vrms.gov.vu); VFSC handles incorporation and licensing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Incorporate as an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). No separate TIN is issued for direct tax because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax for ICs. If the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu, register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act No. 29 of 2019 via VRMS. VAT registration requires the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office certificate, resident agent details, and details of taxable activity; the VRMS assigns a VAT registration number used as the indirect tax identifier.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or direct tax classification election exists under Vanuatu law. A VAT-registered entity may elect to file VAT returns electronically, and a business that makes only zero-rated supplies may elect to register for VAT to recover input VAT, subject to Commissioner approval. Hybrid mismatch and transfer-pricing elections are not applicable because no direct income tax regime is operative.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 in taxable supplies during any consecutive 12-month period; registration is compulsory within 28 days after the month in which the threshold is exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate is currently implemented. VAT-registered businesses must issue tax invoices in paper or electronic form containing required particulars; returns are filed through VRMS electronically. No API-based clearance, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control (CTC) regime is yet operational.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Vanuatu and supply of services to a non-resident recipient are zero-rated where the recipient is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and the services are performed outside Vanuatu or are not consumed directly in Vanuatu. For an M&A advisory boutique, pure offshore advisory services, success fees, and cross-border deal management services to non-resident clients qualify for 0% VAT, provided the contract, invoicing, and payment flows clearly indicate the non-resident destination. Any local onshore services or services connected to Vanuatu property or VU-domiciled target entities must be separately assessed and may be subject to 15% VAT unless the recipient is non-resident and the service is exported.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration or ASYCUDA World electronic filing (for goods transactions; for pure services, this is substituted by a service export declaration/statement)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (only where tangible goods are involved; not required for advisory services)
Signed service agreement/engagement letter evidencing non-resident client and distinct offshore deliverables
Tax invoice issued in compliance with VAT Act, clearly showing 0% export rating and basis of zero-rating
SWIFT/remittance certificate or inward remittance advice evidencing payment from outside Vanuatu
Work papers, board resolutions, and transaction closing records substantiating the M&A advisory services and success fee accrual
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner may conduct audit review of export zero-rating claims. If a zero-rating claim is unsupported or the documentary evidence is deficient, VAT at 15% is assessed on the transaction value, with penalty interest and penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded for fraudulent claims. Criminal prosecution may follow for knowingly false statements. Input VAT recovered in reliance on a zero-rated export may be clawed back, and VAT registration benefits may be revoked. Export proceeds ordinarily should be received in the IC's bank account within 180 days of invoice date; failure to receive remittance without a documented bona fide trade dispute may cause the zero-rating to be reversed and trigger assessment, interest, and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - statutory central bank and exchange-control administration under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 102]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses the M&A advisory IC and supervises its AML/CFT compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for current-account payments and remittance flows consistent with IMF Article VIII obligations; advisory and service fees may be paid abroad without restriction. Capital-account flows are liberalized but must be executed through an authorized dealer, with statistical reporting to the RBV above the prescribed threshold. An International Company (VU_IC) registered under the International Companies Act is treated as non-resident for exchange-control purposes and may hold USD, AUD, and EUR accounts onshore or offshore without RBV convertibility approval; dividend and profit remittance is subject to no material statutory hurdle provided the IC derives no domestic Vanuatu-source business income. Practical constraint: offshore VUV non-deliverable forward (NDF) liquidity is negligible, so settlement and hedging should be denominated in USD or AUD.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender ratio or time-bound repatriation obligation applies in Vanuatu. Under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 102], service receipts of a non-resident IC may be retained indefinitely in foreign currency with an authorized dealer or in an offshore bank account. The only compliance duty is passive: the receiving authorized dealer records the credit on the RBV statistical exchange-control return and performs standard AML/CFT vetting. For the M&A boutique, success-fee wires are current-account service receipts and fall outside any conversion or surrender requirement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-to-MEDIUM with a hard legal cap. Global fintech EMIs (Wise, Revolut Business, Airwallex and similar) generally decline native onboarding of Vanuatu International Companies on jurisdiction-risk grounds, the entity's statutory tax-exempt status, and the enhanced scrutiny attached to a VFSC-licensed M&A advisory. Such EMIs are not authorized deposit-taking institutions under RBV law and cannot provide domestic Vanuatu clearing in VUV. Where an EMI is used strictly as a non-VUV offshore wallet, the IC must still anchor the treasury structure with at least one authorized-dealer account in Vanuatu, and all EMI disbursements must mirror the approved fee schedule with verifiable source-of-funds evidence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is effectively mandatory for first-time account opening of a non-resident IC. At least one natural-person director or senior authorized signatory must attend an in-person interview at the bank's Vanuatu branch or, in a remote-formation scenario, at a VFSC-licensed registered agent's office with the bank's compliance officer connected by video and a notarized attestation completed. Pure document-only or fully remote video-KYC onboarding without any physical meeting is not accepted for Medium-Risk Enhanced accounts; additional signatories may be onboarded remotely after the initial physical interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status combined with non-resident directors and nominee-appearance risk, triggering perceived shell-company or tax-evasion red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation and current registry search; completed beneficial-ownership schedule lodged with the registered agent; certificate of good standing; statutory declaration that the IC conducts no domestic Vanuatu business; board resolution evidencing active M&A advisory mandates; VFSC license; and a substance file (service agreement, professional engagement letter, or qualifying premises arrangement) demonstrating commercial reality.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border success-fee inflows from foreign M&A counterparties without clearly evidenced underlying transaction structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed engagement or advisory agreement with defined fee waterfall; target-company acquisition documentation (LOI, SPA, or closing statement where permitted); period invoice and fee schedule; beneficial-owner source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements; notarized director certification of transaction authenticity; and SWIFT MT103 remittance records matching the transaction counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP-adjacent counterparties or payments routed through high-risk jurisdictions, shell-holding SPVs, or trust chains within the deal flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative-news, sanctions, and PEP screening results for all material counterparties; corporate-ownership chain charts; risk assessment compliant with applicable Vanuatu AML/CFT statutory obligations; registered-agent attestation of continuity of local representation; and a written undertaking to maintain the IC's beneficial-ownership register and to freeze any RBV-flagged remittance pending clarification.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital must arrive by SWIFT MT103 in USD, AUD, or EUR. Vanuatu does not use an IBAN standard, so the receiving authorized dealer requires the full beneficiary name, account number, and bank BIC. The remittance reference must state: 'Capital contribution to VU_IC per shareholder resolution [date]'. Verification pack: certified incorporation documents; extract of the register of members and share-allotment resolution; registered-agent certificate of good standing; and, where gross proceeds exceed the RBV statistical ceiling, the dealer files the applicable exchange-control statistical return. Capital intended for offshore M&A fee working capital must not be applied to domestic Vanuatu transactions, preserving the IC's non-resident tax-exempt status.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for the M&A advisory boutique should be cleared via SWIFT MT103 from a USD or AUD concentration account; authorized dealers require a disbursement file containing the signed engagement mandate, date-issued invoice, and closing or fee-trigger evidence. For escrowed M&A consideration or deferred payment obligations, an irrevocable, confirmed, fully transferable commercial letter of credit advised by a tier-1 Vanuatu bank is the applicable documentary rail, with standby LCs available to back completion undertakings. Domestic VUV clearing rails should be avoided for cross-border flows; VUV balances should be maintained at a near-zero memo level.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/AUD/EUR versus VUV) with tenors matched to documented M&A or capital-flow exposure and executed via authorized dealers
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD and USD/AUD) for hedging balance-sheet and fee-stream mismatches, subject to authorized-dealer execution and RBV statistical reporting
Spot FX contracts for operational treasury needs with tier-1 onshore authorized dealers
Structured hedging products (participating forwards and FX collars) sold by licensed commercial banks where the underlying exposure is a confirmed advisory fee or escrowed consideration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee (International Company renewal payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; no filing return is required, but the registered agent must pay before the end of that month, with no formal grace period under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty normally equal to 10% of the unpaid annual fee; if arrears remain unpaid for 90 days, VFSC may strike the company off the International Companies Register, causing dissolution and loss of legal capacity; restoration is possible only upon payment of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent / Registered Office Renewal Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent (contractual private requirement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual government fee on the anniversary of incorporation; the agent must confirm the registered office and agent for the coming year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew the registered agent engagement will result in the agent resigning and notifying VFSC; VFSC may appoint a replacement or strike off the company if no qualified Vanuatu registered agent is appointed within 60 days.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent and VFSC inspection authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Upon any share transfer or beneficial ownership change; no fixed annual date is prescribed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate, incomplete, or stale UBO records may expose the registered agent to licence sanctions and the company to an investigation under Vanuatu AML/CFT laws; deliberate false statements may lead to monetary penalties and administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory external audit and from filing any financial statements with VFSC, regardless of turnover, asset size, or number of shareholders, unless the company elects for an audit under its own constitutional documentation or a regulated activity requires it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is imposed by the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); if financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS is the broadly accepted standard for international companies, but simple record-keeping reflecting transactions and financial position is the only statutory requirement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO filing is required. The licensed registered agent must collect, verify, and continuously maintain a current register of beneficial owners in accordance with Vanuatu AML/CFT and International Companies law; any transfer of shares that changes beneficial ownership must be reported to the agent immediately, and the agent must retain supporting documentation for VFSC inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 900 per annum (standard fee for international company registered agent and registered office, depending on the selected agent and complexity of the corporate structure)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by law; voluntary preparatory audit or agreed-upon procedures for a boutique M&A advisory typically costs USD 3,000 - USD 7,500 depending on transaction volume and documentation support.

stage_6.form_identifier_and_portal: No official corporate income tax return exists. VFSC registers no CIT. Compliance filing: 'Annual Return / Economic Substance Return under International Companies Act' submitted to VFSC by the registered agent via the VFSC registry portal/paper; there is no Vanuatu CIT e-filing portal.
stage_6.reporting_frequency: Annual; no quarterly CIT instalments or provisional tax.
